turns.patient_opening: I’m an 80-year-old woman. In the last few days I’ve had a fever and a sore throat, and I’m also having a kind of tedious, sensitive pain in my head—forehead pain, right cheek and right temple pain, and also pain in the left temple. I’ve also been sweating a lot more than usual. I work in a daycare and I was in contact with someone who had similar symptoms within the last two weeks.

turns.doctor_question: What color is the rash (for example: red, pink, pale, dark, or yellow)? If there isn’t a rash, you can say “absent.”
Have you noticed any swollen or painful lymph nodes—such as lumps in your neck, under your arms, or in your groin?
turns.patient_answer: I haven’t noticed any swollen or painful lumps in my neck, under my arms, or in my groin.

turns.doctor_question: Have you had diarrhea or noticed you’re going to the bathroom more often than usual?
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t had diarrhea or needed to go to the bathroom more often than usual.

turns.doctor_question: Have any of your family members (such as a parent, sibling, or child) been diagnosed with cluster headaches?
turns.patient_answer: No, I don’t know of any family member diagnosed with cluster headaches.

turns.doctor_question: Do you currently smoke cigarettes (yes or no)?
